attributes.board_name: New York State Board for Dentistry (NYSED Office of the Professions)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Sponsors approved by ADA CERP, AGD PACE (national approval only), New York State Dental Association or NYSED; registered/accredited degree-granting institutions. Sponsor must have at least one full-time employee
rules.new_licensee_rule: No CE in the initial three-year registration period, unless licensed by endorsement of another jurisdiction's license. Shorter registrations: 1.667 hours per month.
rules.audit_note: Random audits every month; keep proof of attendance for six years.

topics.who: State-approved infection control course every 4 years
State-approved NY dental jurisprudence and ethics course, in the first registration period with a CE requirement
Identification and reporting of child abuse and maltreatment, NYSED-approved provider; counts as CE
Prescribers with a DEA registration: pain management, palliative care and addiction every 3 years, attested to the NYS Department of Health
Current live in-person CPR (max 12 h CPR/ACLS/PALS count)

rules.notes: At least 42 of 60 hours live; rest self-study. Must hold and keep current live in-person CPR certification (max 12 h CPR/ACLS/PALS count). One-time 2-hour course on oral health effects of tobacco. Practice-management courses not accepted.
rules.legal_basis: New York State Education Law, Title VIII
